version.changelog: v1.2.0 新增 avs 跨平台一键安装 CLI，支持 WorkBuddy/Claude Code/Cursor 等八个平台；项目结构标准化

llm.summary: The skill is mostly a disclosed storyboard helper, but its project/global memory mechanism can turn untrusted local files into mandatory agent instructions and persist them across projects.

dimensions.detail: The file reads and writes are related to articles, storyboard drafts, validation, and learning records, but the project-relative memory file is trusted based only on its presence in the working directory.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No remote payload retrieval, package installation, tool spoofing, or network execution was found in the inspected artifacts.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md requires reading prior experience before work and says every digest item must be followed, while scripts read arbitrary JSONL text from the current project’s .avs/learnings.jsonl and the user’s global memory file.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill discloses persistence in .avs/learnings.jsonl and ~/.workbuddy/avs/learnings.jsonl, but it also requires post-task writeback, supports promotion to global memory, and recommends upgrading repeated memory into SKILL.md rules without a clear approval boundary.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose, Chinese-language storyboard workflow, helper scripts, validation checks, and bilingual prompt format are broadly coherent with an article-to-video storyboard skill.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review before installing. Use this skill only in projects you trust, because a repository can include .avs/learnings.jsonl content that the skill tells the agent to follow. Avoid promoting project lessons to global memory unless you wrote and approved the exact entry, and periodically inspect or delete ~/.workbuddy/avs/learnings.jsonl if it may contain sensitive or stale preferences.
llm.findings:
[AIG T02] unexpected: Accepted as a material concern: the artifact-backed path reads untrusted project/global learning records and instructs the agent to obey them, with optional promotion into cross-project global memory.
[SDI-1] expected: Persistence is part of the advertised experience-improvement feature, but mandatory writeback and global retention create privacy and cross-session influence risk.
[SDI-2] expected: The global memory path is disclosed and purpose-related, but cross-project reuse is under-scoped and lacks explicit per-entry consent or provenance controls.
[LP3] expected: Local filesystem use is necessary for the helper scripts, but writable project and home-directory memory paths are not constrained by a clear permission contract.
[SQP-1] expected: The broad trigger phrases could cause accidental activation; this is a secondary concern because activation may lead to memory reads and writes.
[TP4] expected: Downgraded: helper scripts only scaffold and check, while the skill instructions direct the agent to generate final storyboard content, so the capability gap is not by itself evidence of tool poisoning.
[SQP-3] expected: Downgraded: Chinese-language operation and bilingual prompts match the skill’s stated audience and workflow; this is usability guidance rather than a security concern.
